name: Tando Adam
purpose: City-specific cadastral and public parcel geometry investigation; registry evidence, retrieved geometry and runtime qualification are assessed separately.

queries.query: Tando Adam official cadastral map parcel Sindh land records GIS Pakistan
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Board of Revenue Sindh, Sindh Zameen/LARMIS public land-record portal, the official ruled-card service, and official GIS/cadastral program documentation. Tando Adam-specific survey-map evidence appears in an official Sindh High Court record, but no anonymous public parcel vector endpoint was found.

queries.result: Official-domain discovery returned the Sindh Board of Revenue public land-record portal and its cadastral/deh-map services. The result set did not expose an anonymous parcel geometry response, CRS, or safe native parcel identity for Tando Adam.

officialSources.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh
officialSources.observation: Official Sindh Zameen portal advertises public land-record, deh-map, survey-register, property-register, and registry services. It is a record/search portal, not evidence of an open parcel vector API.

officialSources.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh
officialSources.observation: Current public ASP.NET ruled-card route exposes District, Taluka/Town, Ward/Quarter, and Survey no selectors. GET returned HTTP 200 and the page contained no map service, geometry schema, CRS declaration, or vector endpoint.

officialSources.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh
officialSources.observation: Official LARMIS page states that Sindh maintains digital district/deh maps and digital survey-number maps, and describes integration with computerized land records. This establishes provincial GIS/cadastral capability, not anonymous Tando Adam geometry access.

Official court record cites Directorate of Settlements Survey and Land Records evidence using Deh Map and City Survey sheets for Tando Adam. This is local cadastral/survey evidence, not an open geometry download.

requests.outcome: Readable current ASP.NET form; schema is selector-based record lookup (district, taluka/town, ward/quarter, survey number), with no public feature-service URL or geometry response.

Bounded Sanghar district selection POST using the page's unchanged hidden state and public selector values returned ASP.NET invalid-postback/event-validation error. No bypass or repeated mutation was attempted; no parcel fields or geometry were returned.
Official route identified, but direct TLS fetch failed certificate hostname verification for the www host. No certificate exception was used; the non-www ruled-card route was fetched successfully.

registryBasis: Board of Revenue Sindh is an evidenced provincial land-record/cadastral custodian, and an official High Court record cites Directorate of Settlements Survey and Land Records survey sheets for Tando Adam. No local open parcel API was verified.

sourceCandidate.publisher: Board of Revenue, Government of Sindh

remainingUncertainty: The Board of Revenue may hold Tando Adam city-survey/deh geometry behind the public ruled-card or other non-indexed routes, but the current anonymous public interface did not expose a safe vector response. The POST error is an interface limitation, not evidence of citywide absence.
